items.title: Safety

items:
Toulouse Mongoose is a beloved retreat for vacationing families and groups heading to the Florida Panhandle for a weeklong summer escape or a long weekend with friends. Nestled in Historic Grayton Beach, this charming beach house—located just two homes from the Gulf—offers an inviting blend of comfort, space, and coastal charm for creating lasting memories.

Many families become repeat guests to enjoy their beach holiday at our home. We love to have you visit again and again and use the home to switch off from work and relax. The home is perfect for a couple of families and your kids to spread out and build memories together. Enjoy listening to the surf from the front porch after a long, fun day at the beach. The large private pool is the perfect spot for kids to enjoy, with a shaded area that has plenty of space to relax out of the sun.

Summer stays run Sunday to Sunday, giving you a full weekend to settle in and enjoy, with less traffic to contend with on arrival and departure. Step outside to find two convenient beach access points—the closest just 75 yards from your back door—leading to plenty of beach for your chairs, paddleboards, umbrellas, and more.

Unbeatable Location & Features
Prime Spot: Only two houses from the Gulf, with downtown Grayton’s restaurants like The Red Bar and Chiringo, shops, and entertainment a short stroll away.
Private Pool Area: Features a large heated pool with a waterfall, 6 cushioned chaise lounge chairs, a Weber grill, and a shaded porch with a Coca-Cola bar lounge seating and teak cafe table seats 8.
Spacious Layout: Spread across three levels, this open and airy home offers room for families to unwind together or enjoy their own space. The front porch adds to its charm.
Parking & Storage: Space for three cars and ample space under the front porch for bicycles. Renting a golf cart is also doable if you want to open air ride to other neighborhoods, but not necessary.

Comfortable Accommodations
Top Floor: Master King bedroom with en suite bathroom, TV, quiet seating area, and French doors opening to beach views east and west.
Main Floor: Queen bedroom, a twin bedroom with two beds, a modern bathroom with glass-door shower, a well-equipped kitchen, separate dining room, living room, and a cozy video/book nook for kids.
First Floor: King bedroom with TV and seating, plus a bunk room with two twin bunks and a seating area—both with French doors to the covered porch.
Extras: Dedicated laundry room, outdoor shower by the pool, and Wi-Fi throughout (including poolside). The main TV is in the living room, with additional TVs in select bedrooms.
Extra top secret: there's a book nook for children to find on the main floor. It's a great spot for kids needing some chill time from the beach to relax after a little too much sun or wanting to read a book during a cloudy day. Shhhh, the kids will find this on their own.

Coastal Charm
Toulouse Mongoose exudes an upscale island vibe with original artwork—like Walter Anderson block prints—and whimsical touches that make every corner feel welcoming.

You are a short bike ride from Watercolor, Seaside, Seagrove, and Blue Mountain. Kids can enjoy old school freedom of riding bikes to spots on their own. There's a nature trail to also rid into that is just north of the entrance to Grayton Beach State Park. There's parking for cars. The nature path is also perfect for a relaxing walk in the live oak canopy.

Complimentary beach cart and chairs are provided for your convenience.

Why Guests Return
This is more than a rental—it’s a home away from home. With beach views from the front porch and master deck, a short walk to Grayton’s vibrant scene, and a layout designed for both togetherness and privacy, it’s no wonder so many families return year after year.

Good to Know
Summer Rentals: Sunday to Sunday, starting Memorial Day weekend.
No Pets: Only Florida residents with pet permits are allowed on the beach.
Guest Info: About two weeks before arrival, you’ll receive an email with house details, local tips, key code, Wi-Fi info, and more. Guests sign a Disclaimer and Release of Liability form.
Preferred Guests: We love hosting those with positive reviews from past short-term rentals.

Come experience why Toulouse Mongoose is a standout choice for your Grayton Beach vacation. Relax, explore, and make memories—book your stay today!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Grayton Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and on a lake. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Traveling with kids? Consider Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
